question: Where is the nearest restaurant you encounter heading toward Hermosa Beach Historical Society Museum, Hermosa Beach, CA from the Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.394096 33.864154)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: The Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA

[3].display_name: Hermosa Beach Historical Society Museum, Hermosa Beach, CA
